# Corentin Renard

Corentin Renard is a full stack web designer based in France. He designs and develops custom websites for founders, local brands and teams, with services covering UI/UX design, Nuxt/Vue development, landing pages, showcase websites, e-commerce and ongoing maintenance.

## Services

- Landing page projects start from 900 EUR.
- Showcase websites start from 2500 EUR.
- E-commerce projects start from 4500 EUR.
- Custom projects are quoted after scoping.
